name: Baked falafel bowl

steps.text: Reheat the baked falafel on a tray in a 180°C oven for 8 minutes. If you have not made it yet, bake it first (see the falafel part).
steps.cue: The patties are hot through with crisp edges.
steps.tip: Use the oven, not the microwave, which turns the crust soft.

steps.text: Soak bulgur in boiling water for 15 minutes.
steps.cue: The grains are tender and the water is absorbed. Drain any extra and fluff.
steps.tip: Use boiling water and cover the bowl tightly so the steam does the cooking.

steps.text: Assemble bulgur, falafel, vegetables, hummus and dressing.

storage: Store the baked falafel, bulgur and vegetables separately for up to 3 days. Reheat the falafel in a 180°C oven for 8 minutes to re-crisp. Add the sauces just before eating.
